name: Westfield Century City Shopping Centre
demographics: Westfield Century City attracts an affluent, cosmopolitan demographic primarily consisting of high-income professionals, entertainment industry executives, and upscale families from the Westside Los Angeles area including Beverly Hills, Bel Air, and West Hollywood. The trade area serves a sophisticated consumer base with household incomes significantly above the national average, drawn to luxury shopping and premium dining experiences. Visitors typically range from 25-65 years old with strong representation in the 35-54 age bracket, featuring dual-income households and fashion-conscious millennials. The center's proximity to major entertainment studios and creative agencies results in a clientele with refined tastes and substantial discretionary spending power, seeking both established luxury brands and emerging contemporary labels.
description: Westfield Century City Shopping Centre stands as one of Los Angeles's premier luxury shopping destinations, located in the heart of Century City at 10250 Santa Monica Boulevard. This iconic open-air regional mall underwent a transformative $1 billion renovation, emerging as a sophisticated retail and dining destination that seamlessly blends high-end fashion, entertainment, and culinary experiences. The center features an impressive roster of anchor tenants including Bloomingdale's and Nordstrom, complemented by luxury retailers such as Tiffany & Co., alongside contemporary favorites like Alo Yoga, Aritzia, and UNIQLO. Beyond shopping, visitors can enjoy world-class dining at Eataly's multi-level Italian marketplace, Katsuya's upscale Japanese cuisine, and innovative concepts like Super Peach by Momofuku and Chamberlain Coffee. The center also offers exceptional entertainment options with AMC Theatres, interactive experiences at American Girl and CAMP's Gabby's Dollhouse installation, and modern conveniences including electric vehicle charging stations, free Wi-Fi throughout the property, and package check lockers for shopper convenience.
summary: Westfield Century City is a premier luxury shopping destination in Los Angeles featuring high-end retailers like Bloomingdale's, Nordstrom, and Tiffany & Co., alongside contemporary brands and world-class dining options including Eataly and Katsuya. This open-air center offers a sophisticated blend of fashion, entertainment, and culinary experiences with modern amenities in the heart of Century City.
